title: Ox Passion Blackcurrant Rebena Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Blackcurrant Rebena delivers the bold, juicy taste of rich Blackcurrant, inspired by a classic cordial-style flavour. The blackcurrant note is dark and fruity with a smooth sweetness and just enough sharpness to keep things lively. It’s a deep, flavourful vape with a comforting, familiar edge that fans of berry vapes will love. Formulated with nicotine salts for a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices. Best paired with pod kits, vape pens, and starter systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts are made by Oxva and designed to work seamlessly with the XLIM pod system and a wide range of refillable MTL vape kits.
